chat.text:
I've been working on a Perl script to parse some very large HTML dumps, and I'm using the following regex to extract all the anchor tags and their hrefs: `my @links = $html_content =~ /<a\s+[^>]*href="([^"]*)"[^>]*>/g;`. 

I'm worried about catastrophic backtracking or general inefficiency given the size of my files. Do you think this approach is efficient enough for production, or is there a significantly faster way to do it in Perl? I'd really like to know how this actually performs on a real-world dataset before I commit to it.
